title: I made a pixel endless platformer in one evening: my idea, AI implementation (Spore Rift)
author: Due-Yak-360

comments.author: Due-Yak-360
comments.body:
I had an idea for an endless platformer through glowing mushroom worlds, with fiery portals between them wreathed in roses, some in colours that don't exist. I described it to Claude and iterated: it wrote all the code, the pixel art and sound effects are generated by that code, and the cover and screenshots are rendered by the game itself.



What I did: the concept, the worlds and portal design, and a lot of playtesting and tuning (I asked for smoother movement, easier difficulty, shorter worlds so you see all five fast, then faster loops).



Play it in the browser (desktop or mobile): [https://the-old-tester.itch.io/spore-rift](https://the-old-tester.itch.io/spore-rift)



Happy to answer questions about the workflow. Feedback on difficulty welcome!
